howToUpdate: When an RFI response arrives, set status to Evidenced, add the dated wants, set the bed rules, and clear openFields. Publish only the buy box. Do not add rates, names, emails, or contract terms.

base.summary: Sites with planning permission where reserved matters have been discharged, and 3 to 4 bed homes.

wants: Self-contained homes for one household, 1 to 4 bed, inside the City of Edinburgh boundary only. Outside the boundary is excluded.
Strongest demand is 1, 3 and 4 bed. 2 bed is lower priority, because the council appears to have more 2 bed supply.
Within 1.5 miles of a grocery shop and public transport.
More than 2 temporary accommodation properties in one stair, or more than 20% in one street, needs a management strategy. Clustering should be flagged.
Larger buildings and conversions are considered case by case. The council is seeking 12 to 16 bed supported accommodation that is HMO compliant, with en-suite rooms and staff space.
Home Share and Shared House intake is currently suspended, so no HMO or shared houses for this route.
The home must be capable of full compliance before call-off. That covers insurance, certification and licences.

Manchester.note: The MCC Private Sector Leasing RFI is still due 30 Nov 2026.
wants: Homes inside the City of Manchester only, split north and south or central.
1 to 5 bed houses or flats for temporary accommodation, with all bed sizes in scope until a demand mix is confirmed.
An optional adapted route at three specification levels, accepted after inspection.
Council furnishes and the landlord provides basic fixtures.
Current energy, gas and electrical certificates are required. No council tax arrears.
The landlord must have sufficient title and consents to grant the lease.
North: M9, M8, M40, parts of M4. South or central: M1, M2, parts of M3, parts of M4, M11, M12, M13, M14, M15, parts of M16, M18, M19, M20, M21, M22, M23, M90.
